single_hypothesis: Large forward shapes lose time to per-task command overhead and burst fragmentation: raising the forward tile budget from 8K to 32K elements (UB permits: forward needs only 2x2B/element) with a wave-balance guard cuts task count 4x and MTE commands 4x on those shapes.
preceding_simulator_study: Naive R=8 for mid (S=1024) lost 13% wall in the CA simulator to the 3-vs-2 wave split (T=128 over 48 cores). Hence the balance guard: fat tasks accepted only when tasks >= 8*cores (deep queue, rounding negligible) or <= cores (single wave).
